notes.title: Long Story Short – V0.10 is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


V0.10 is finally here! I know it took longer than expected, and I appreciate your patience. My plan is for the next version to arrive much faster.

This update includes the complete V0.10 chapter, a few new improvements, and important bug fixes.



Changes

Complete V0.10 chapter.

Added missing animation for the Vanessa + Customer scene (hotel).

Ann will only give a BJ to one of the motel guys if they actually have sex at the motel.

Emily’s relationship can now progress further depending on whether you touched her, not just if you joined her in bed.

If you’re not dating Ann, you can now avoid watching her have sex with the motel guys.

Pressing O now toggles the text overlay.

Added a new Help section in the main menu to see all keybinds.

Pressing F12 (default Steam screenshot) will no longer bring back the UI if it’s hidden (by pressing H).



Bug Fixes

Fixed an instance where the game jumped to the wrong scene after talking with Vanessa outside.

Fixed a freeze when loading during the Vanessa/Customer memory sequence on the bus.

Fixed the issue where the game stopped during Ann’s texts instead of showing the game end screen.

Fixed an issue where rolling back and then clicking advance sometimes caused the music to change unexpectedly.



cheers 🍻,
TTrick

notes.title: Long Story Short V0.10 public alpha is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


It's been a while, but I'm excited to let you know that I've just made the latest alpha version of Long Story Short available!



Change logs:

2 new scenes with a corrupted Ann + NTR scene.

1 scene with Vanessa (includes sex scene).

1 scene with Vanessa's Mom (includes sex scene).

1 scene with Emily - lewd scene with the MC + NTR scene.

359 renders

18 animations



Changes

Added missing animation for Vanessa + Customer scene (at the hotel)

Ann will only give BJ to one of the guys from the motel if they had sex before.



Bug fixes:

Fixed an instance where the game jumped to the wrong scene after talking with Vanessa outside.

If you saved and tried to load during Vanessa/Customer memory sequence on the bus, the game would freeze.

Fixed Ann/MC handjob animation that didn't play out correctly



Important Note: This is still an alpha build, which means it's not yet complete, and you may run into bugs, unfinished content, or placeholders. More content is still planned for v0.10. 



How to access the alpha branch on Steam:
[olist]
Right-click Long Story Short in your Steam Library

Select Properties

Go to the Betas tab

Choose public_alpha from the dropdown

Close the window — Steam will start downloading the alpha version automatically
[/olist]




Why release it now? I didn't want to keep Steam players in the dark any longer. Even though the final version isn't ready, I wanted to give you all a chance to see the progress and share your thoughts.



Thanks for your patience and support. I'm thrilled to share this update with you!



Cheers 🍻,

TTrick.

notes.title: Dev update and a bit more
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


Some personal stuff – you can skip to the technical stuff about the update below if you find this boring

I found myself struggling a lot with how I wanted to start this post. As someone who's been developing the game for years and sharing a lot about my development progress (and more intimate details of how the project came to life), I tend to forget that when I upload the game to a new platform (Steam in this case), many of you just discovered it and know nothing about me or the project.

Long Story Short is my hobby, and I find joy every time I work on it. Besides that, I also have a family and a full-time job. I work on the game whenever I have free time, and sometimes I forget I should step away from development to write these updates so you know I'm actively working on it. I guess that's just my way of saying that if I'm ever quiet, it means I'm working as hard as I can to pump out more content.

I always promise myself I'll try to write dev updates more frequently, but because I'm not a native English speaker, these posts take me quite a while to draft—sometimes a whole day—without any progress on the update, which can feel like a waste of time. But at this point, I should know better. You don’t really know what’s going on behind the scenes unless I tell you, so I should remind myself (again) that writing these dev updates from time to time should be a priority.

What I've been doing since I first uploaded the game to Steam

The first couple of weeks, I spent most of my time fixing bugs, reading feedback, and getting used to this new platform. Then I started implementing translation into my engine.
For those who don't know, I'm using my own engine, and why I decided to do that is a very long story I don’t mind sharing in the future if you’re curious.

Anyway, the game is already being translated into multiple languages, but I found some bugs here and there that cause certain lines (especially those with game variables) not to be translated. I was hoping to upload the game with translation support weeks ago, but I decided to delay it to make sure everything works smoothly.

Second, I'd like to say the update is progressing really nicely! It’s hard for me to say exactly what percentage of the update is done, because I tend to add or remove things as I test it from start to finish. This part is always a bit awkward for me, because on one hand I want to tell you exactly which scenes I’ve finished, but on the other hand, I don’t want to spoil anything—so I’ll just share some previews, and you can try to fill in the gaps yourself. :)

Last point I'd like to address
I know early games are scary because you don’t know what you’re going to get in the end. But at least for me, I don’t see a reality where I won’t finish this game, which has become a huge part of my life at this point.

Let’s finish up with some previews!

notes.title: Save the date! October 24th 2024!
notes.content:
It's my first post, I hope you're all doing well!
So, I've finally set a specific date, as mentioned in the title – October 24th, 2024!

I've been working non-stop to set everything up and make it possible.
I haven't completed everything yet, but I believe I can finish it in time.

I'm both excited and nervous, and I hope you'll enjoy the game!

I'd also like to address some questions I've seen here and in other forums.

 Currently, the game has no translations and is in English only. However, I'm working on implementing translation support, and hopefully, I can find some great people to translate it into other languages. :)
 I've been working on the game since 2019, with a big break in the middle to build my own engine. That's why some of the early renders are a bit outdated. While working on new content, I’m also reworking some of the early renders. I'm the type of person who likes to keep moving forward, and I don’t like the idea of halting development to completely remake the game from scratch. This approach seems to be working well so far.
I'm very active on Discord and really enjoy hearing people's opinions and suggestions. If you have something on your mind, feel free to share, and I might just incorporate it. :)


That’s it for now—just the first of many posts!

Cheers 🍻,
TTrick
